claims.text: Cuộc vấn đáp hay nhất thường kết thúc ở một giả định ngầm mà chưa ai gọi tên. Mời đọc [Giả định ngầm](gia-dinh-ngam.md).

sources.quote: The problem is how Socrates can claim that position W is false, when the only thing he has established is its inconsistency with other premises whose truth he has not tried to establish in the elenchus.
One issue that frequently arises in standardization is an argument’s dependence on premises and conclusions which are not explicitly stated.
